name: Indiana University Columbus
oos_note: Public IU regional campus. Non-resident undergraduate annual tuition & fees 2025-26 from official columbus.iu.edu/admissions/affordability-aid/tuition-fees.html: banded tuition $16,991.66/sem + mandatory student services fee $621.92/sem = $17,613.58/sem x 2 = $35,227.16/yr (tuition & fees only, no housing). Resident equivalent (~$10,761-10,997) matches the known in-state figure.
